description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ReportingMethodConfigurationService, testing its methods related to ReportingMethod entities in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for ReportingMethodConfigurationService, testing CRUD operations and retrieval methods for ReportingMethod objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by setting up the ReportingMethodConfigurationService instance and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of ReportingMethod objects via the service, mocking the DAO layer.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single ReportingMethod by ID.

methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple ReportingMethods by IDs.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ReportingMethod by name.

methods.description: Tests counting ReportingMethods based on search filters.
